RNFilterEpochs models the keyed receiver live-generation table of STANDARD.md (The keyed filter value): Install(g) with g the next of the newest and the last generation wrapping to 1, Retire dropping the oldest when the table is full, and Check(e, k), epoch 0 refused when keyed, an epoch naming no live generation refused on a comparison with no MAC, a live one costing one MAC; invariants TypeOK, NeverKeyedAtZero, WrapSkipsZero, AtLeastTwoLiveAfterRotation, DeadEpochRefusedWithoutMac, OneMacPerLiveEpoch, LegitimateNeverRefused, OldKeyRefused and LiveGenerationsDistinct; passing control MCRNFilterEpochs.cfg and reversed witnesses MCRNFilterEpochsBrokenAcceptZero.cfg (NeverKeyedAtZero) and MCRNFilterEpochsBrokenWrapToZero.cfg (WrapSkipsZero). The code that implements it is owed: the prefilter check is unkeyed only in 1.0.

RNUringDriver models the io_uring server driver in sdk/rocketnet_server_uring_linux.cpp (one ring on the main thread, no worker thread): Reserve is rocketnet_server_uring_start_packet (one fetch_add, NULL when full); Finish(s) is rocketnet_server_uring_finish_packet and Abort(s) is rocketnet_server_uring_abort_packet (the slot from rocketnet_server_uring_slot); Submit, Reap and ResetIndex are rocketnet_server_uring_send_packets (one SENDMSG per slot with bytes, submitted in chunks no larger than the free SQ space, reaped until every send of the call has its CQE, then the index reset to 0); KernelComplete(s), KernelFill(b) and KernelStop are the kernel posting send, receive and final (no F_MORE) CQEs; Reap(c) is rocketnet_server_uring_reap_cqe by tag kind (send, recv, cancel), the recv case rocketnet_server_uring_receive_cqe copying into the fill bank whether reaped from receive_packets or inside send_packets, and the term case re-arming through rocketnet_server_uring_arm unless destroying; ReturnBuffer(b) is the io_uring_buf_ring_add at the end of rocketnet_server_uring_receive_cqe; Swap is rocketnet_server_uring_receive_packets and TransportReads is rocketnet_server_uring_process_packets; Destroy and Free are rocketnet_server_uring_destroy (cancel every multishot, wait for each cancel CQE and each multishot's last CQE, then free the buffer rings, the ring, the sockets and the memory); invariants TypeOK, NoReuseWhileKernelOwned, ExposedStable, BufferReturnedAfterCopy and FreedOnlyWhenDrained, liveness SubmittedEventuallyFree and DestroyEventuallyFrees under SpecFair; passing control MCRNUringDriver.cfg and reversed witnesses MCRNUringDriverBrokenResetBeforeReap.cfg (NoReuseWhileKernelOwned) and MCRNUringDriverBrokenOneBank.cfg (ExposedStable). Where the code refines the model: one multishot per queue rather than one; Submit runs in chunks interleaved with Reap, with sends in flight capped at ROCKETNET_URING_ENTRIES; a cancel that finds no request is sent again; and destroy's wait is bounded (ROCKETNET_URING_DESTROY_WAIT_ROUNDS): a destroy that gives up never reaches Free, it exits the ring and closes the sockets but leaks the kernel-visible memory (buffer rings, queues, driver allocation) rather than freeing it, counted by rocketnet_server_uring_leaked_bytes and rocketnet_server_uring_leaked_drivers, so FreedOnlyWhenDrained holds on both branches. Exercised by test_server_uring_probe (including the give-up branch through rocketnet_server_uring_test_stall_destroy) and test_server_uring_wire_ipv4 (functional/rocketnet_functional_tests.cpp).
